 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Topstories News No winner of major lotto games on Sunday as Ultra Lotto jackpot hits P440.6 million 
 By GMA News Published October 25, 2026 10:08pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Screenshot: PCSO There were no winners of either of the major lotto games played by the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office on Sunday, October 25, 2026, with one jackpot now well over P440 million.
 No bettor chose the winning combination of 38-48-55-57-05-50 for the Ultra Lotto 6/58 game, whose jackpot has risen to a whopping P440,654,674.87 since there has been no Ultra Lotto winner since 10 bettors split the P76.3-million pot in May.
 There was also no winner of the Superlotto 6/49 game, with PCSO drawing the winning combination of 49-38-12-07-33-34 for the prize which has risen to P66,732,591.64.
 Click here for the complete PCSO lotto results for Sunday, October 25, 2026. — BM, GMA News
